canonicalIngredients.name: chicken breast
observations: 1 lb halved into 4 thin filets, pounded even (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: chipotle in adobo
observations: 1 tbsp diced in marinade + 1 tbsp in mayo; sub 1 tsp smoked paprika or omit (s0)

canonicalIngredients.name: salt
observations: 1 tsp flakes chicken + 1/2 tsp pico + 1/2 tsp mayo (s0)

canonicalIngredients.name: lime
observations: 1 juiced in pico + 1 tbsp juice in mayo + wedges (s0)
3 tbsp juice marinade + 1 zested + 2 tbsp juice in rice (s1)

canonicalIngredients.name: rice
observations: 1 cup long-grain white, rinsed, cooked in 1.5 cups water (s1)
1 batch cilantro-lime or white or brown, 3-4 cups cooked (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: corn kernels
observations: 1.5 cups frozen, sauteed in butter/oil, or 1 can (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: onion
observations: 1/2 small red chopped raw or pickled (s1)

causalSequence: mix own spice coat: oil + cumin, paprika, oregano, onion powder (+ chipotle in adobo s0/s1, chili powder s2)
coat chicken; marinate (s1 2 h-overnight; s0 brief; s2 straight to pan)
cook rice; stir through lime zest, lime juice, coriander (s0 shortcuts with microwave packet)
mix pico de gallo: tomato, onion, coriander, lime, salt (s0)
sear chicken in hot pan 5-8 min; splash water to lift stuck marinade (s0); rest 5 min then dice (s2)
warm black beans; saute frozen corn (s2)
assemble bowls: rice base, chicken, beans, corn, avocado, tomato/pico; toppings build-your-own
techniqueFacts: all three season the chicken with an own-mixed blend of single spices and/or chipotle in adobo — none uses a packet taco seasoning mix; s0 explicitly frames the dish against 'out-of-the-packet' spice-mix meals (GF lever: single spices avoid wheat-filler risk in packet mixes)
s0 and s2 are tagged gluten-free; s0 carries a disclaimer to check ingredient panels on specific brands (relevant to corn chips, chipotle in adobo, stock-based extras)
chipotle in adobo is the smoky flavour lever in s0/s1; s2 stays dry-rub only (cumin + paprika + chili powder); s0 subs smoked paprika if unavailable

chicken format diverges: s0 dices 2 cm pieces before cooking (6-8 min stirring); s1 marinates strips 2 h+ then 5 min in hot pan; s2 pounds thin filets, 2-4 min/side over high heat to 165 F, rests 5 min, dices after
rice diverges: s1/s2 cook cilantro-lime rice (lime zest + juice + coriander folded into hot rice); s0 shortcuts with a 450 g microwave packet
s0 deglazes with 1-2 tbsp water so the tomato-paste marinade doesn't burn
bowl core repeats in all three: rice base + chicken + black beans + corn + avocado + tomato; toppings are build-your-own
s0 layers crunch (100 g corn chips) and a chipotle mayo drizzle; s1 adds a head of chopped romaine under/with the rice
s2 sautes frozen corn in butter or oil before adding, or swaps in canned
meal-prep pattern in all three: components stored separately 2-4 days refrigerated; avocado/guacamole/pico best fresh; s0 preps marinade, pico, mayo up to 2 days ahead
totals: s0 30 min (15 prep/15 cook); s2 30 min; s1 stretches to ~3 h only because of the 2 h marinate
